{{Quote|You catch the latest feed? Republic took the Kalsunor system, oh-five-hundred this morning.|An Imperial soldier|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Republic breached the [[Stygian Caldera]] and '''attacked''' the [[Kalsunor system/Legends|Kalsunor system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] near the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The Republic's forces captured the star system, achieving a victory deep in Imperial territory.
